what_this_is: JudgeEscrowV3: the settlement must pay what the verdict awarded. V2 let the verdict hash and the shares describe different decisions, and in our own data they did.

proof.what_this_shows: V3 refuses an unchallenged finalization that pays anything other than what the provisional awarded — the exact divergence that let Base Sepolia job 9 commit an INDETERMINATE verdict allocating nothing and pay the provider 9900 in the same transaction.
proof.refusal_method: eth_call against the deployed bytecode and live chain state — the contract declining, not a local simulation
